system.description:
Through the sight of the third eye you read the life force of those around you, judging their nature and the hurts they carry with a touch.

This power functions exactly as the Obeah power of the same name. You must touch the subject; no challenge is needed. Spend Mental Traits cumulatively to learn information: one reveals whether the subject is mortal, vampire, ghoul or other; two reveals how much damage she has suffered; three reveals the blood in her system; and four reveals any diseases. The same touch serves for medical diagnosis at one Mental Trait per condition examined. Valeren retests with Awareness.
